objectives.title: Data Protection by Design Safeguards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding technical and organisational measures integrated into system architecture and processing operations.
criteria: Requirements for integrating safeguards into processing workflows.
Application of design safeguards both when determining the means of processing and throughout the processing itself.

objectives.title: Data Protection by Default Settings
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding baseline system settings restricting personal data usage.
criteria: Default limitations on personal data collection volumes.
Default restrictions on the scope of data processing.
Automatic limits on data storage duration.
Default settings preventing public accessibility of personal data.

objectives.title: Compliance Certification Alignment
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding an approved Article 42 certification mechanism used as evidence of data-protection-by-design-and-default compliance.
criteria: References to an approved certification mechanism pursuant to Article 42.
The certification is cited specifically as evidence of compliance with the by-design and by-default obligations of paragraphs 1 and 2.
